clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1.  Scope — Requirements for manufacture, dimensions and tolerances, and marking for injection moulded and machined HDPE 90° tees for portable water supplies.

clauses.title: Overall laying lengths and tolerances thereon
clauses.text: 2.1 Overall laying lengths and tolerances thereon shall be as follows : Nominal Diameter Laying Length mm mm 20 36.5 ± 1 25 39 ± 1 32 46 ± 1 Note — For general requirements, regarding material, manufacture, methods of test, etc.refer toIS 8008 (Part1):2003. Injection moulded high density polyethylene (HDPE)  fittings for portable water supplies : PART 1General requirements for fittings. For detailed information, refer to IS  8008 (Part 3 ) :2003  Specification for injection moulded high density polyethylene (HDPE) fittings for potable water supplies : Part3  specific requirements for 90° tees. SUMMARY OF IS 8008 (PART 3) : 2003 INJECTION MOULDED HIGH DENSITY POLYETHYLENE (HDPE) FITTINGS FOR POTABLE WATER SUPPLIES PART 3 SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS FOR 90O TEES (First Revision) 40 63 ± 2 50 75 ± 2 63 80 ± 2 75 88 ± 2 90 98.5 ± 2 110 122.5 ± 3 125 135 ± 3 140 145 ± 3 160 157 ± 3 Note — For typical illustration of 90° tee see  Fig.1 of   the standard.

clauses.title: Outside diameter and wall
clauses.text: 2.2 Outside diameter and wall thickness at ends for welding shall be in accordance with IS 8008 (Part 1) : 2003.
